codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
preserved_requirement: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning noisy history, improving PR descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing code behavior. Use for "make this easy to review", "tidy this PR", "clean up commits", or "annotate the diff".
proof: Pinned source hash, deterministic build, frontmatter parser, link check, security scan; live behavior pending where stated in manifest.
reason: Namespaced frontmatter prevents collisions; Codex boundary note is added where runtime or naming requires it.

codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning noisy history, improving PR descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing code behavior. Use for "make this easy to review", "tidy this PR", "clean up commits", or "annotate the diff".

native_mapping.fallback: Report the exact missing dependency; do not complete or substitute that step.

permission_gates: Current operator authorization and native permissions govern actions. Source distribution grants no activation.

behavioral_proof.positive: Source coverage and deterministic rendering checked; live operation not executed.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Instructions require an exact capability gap and incomplete step; live failure path not executed.
behavioral_proof.error: Native permissions and refusal remain binding; live error path not executed.
